label: Oil embargo begins
description: An Arab oil embargo on the United States starts on 19 October 1973. Oil prices nearly quadruple by January 1974.

label: Lehman Brothers fails
description: The investment bank files for bankruptcy on 15 September 2008, in the middle of the global financial crisis.

label: Record as quoted
description: Copper reaches its highest monthly average as quoted so far. That record holds until May 2021.

label: Pandemic declared
description: The World Health Organization says COVID-19 can be characterized as a pandemic, on 11 March 2020.

label: Grasberg mine accident
description: A mud rush at the Grasberg Block Cave mine in Indonesia on 8 September 2025 disrupts operations. The operator declares force majeure to its customers.

label: New record as quoted
description: Copper's monthly average sets a new high as quoted, the highest since the series starts in 1960.

label: China joins the WTO
description: China becomes the 143rd member of the World Trade Organization on 11 December 2001, after fifteen years of talks.

label: Russia invades Ukraine
description: Russian military operations begin inside Ukraine on 24 February 2022. The UN Secretary-General calls the offensive against the UN Charter.

label: US tariff on semi-finished copper products
description: A 50 percent US tariff on semi-finished copper products and copper-intensive derivative products takes effect on 1 August 2025. Refined copper, ores, concentrates and scrap are not tariffed at first.
